currentArc: The hamsters are fully embracing their new backstage crew roles, despite wardrobe malfunctions.
runningGags: The hamsters constantly try to copy whatever the jester is doing with disastrously cute results.

episodes.title: The First Juggling Ball
episodes.summary: The hamster couple met the cheerful jester as he set up his carnival act and watched him juggle.

episodes.title: Backstage Costume Chaos
episodes.summary: The hamsters attempted to try on the carnival's backstage costume pieces and got hilariously stuck inside a giant jester hat.
